headline: Greaves Cotton Limited: Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
sum: Greaves Cotton Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, intimated to NSE on 23 June 2026 as a corporate restructuring step; the subsidiary's name, authorized capital, and intended business purpose are not disclosed in the exchange intimation.
implication: WOS incorporation post-announcement may signal restructuring for asset-holding, regulatory separation, or operational ringfencing under the Companies Act; review whether this triggered NCLT Form INC-32A filing, shareholding pattern notification (Schedule VI), and consolidated financial reporting implications under IND AS 110.
detail: Greaves Cotton Limited, a listed industrial company, informed the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) of the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary on 23 June 2026. The intimation was filed via NSE's corporate action portal (GREAVESCOT_23062026215129_GCL_Intimation_for_WOS_Incorporation_updatedsd.pdf). The filing does not disclose the subsidiary's name, authorized share capital, paid-up capital, or business purpose. As a listed company, Greaves Cotton is required under Regulation 30 (LODR 2015) and Schedule III to make timely disclosures of material events; subsidiary incorporation falls within this ambit if material. The subsidiary structure may be used for business segmentation, asset isolation, or special purpose vehicle creation.

framework.note: Definition of 'subsidiary'; WOS is a 100% subsidiary.
Incorporation of private company; filing Form INC-7 or INC-32 with Registrar of Companies (MCA).
